description: Pyretechnics is a Python library of wildland-fire behaviour equations and spread algorithms. The maintainers publish modules for fuel and moisture definitions, surface and crown fire, spotting, burning grid cells and an Eulerian level-set spread method. Users assemble fuels, terrain, wind and moisture fields through a common space-time cube, then run fire-behaviour calculations for the chosen grid and period. Outputs include simulated fire spread or cell-level behaviour. Geographic coverage and temporal resolution follow the input rasters and weather. EPL-2.0 source and API documentation are public. A limitation is that the library supplies core equations, not a validated national fire-risk product; local fuels and weather assumptions determine results. It can generate wildfire exposure for power lines, roads and settlements. The catalogue's model-nist-fds-smokeview is a separate fluid-dynamics fire simulator at a different scale. No wildfire raster or simulation was run.
